name: Solar panels, inverters and batteries (assembly and distribution)

problems.words: Panel rates drop after we buy and we lose on stock in the godown
quick_ideas: Note stock on hand and the rate you bought at — shows your real exposure
Buy closer to confirmed orders — less stock exposed to rate drops.

workzap_build.text: a daily rate board for buying and selling rates with stock value updated.

problems.ask_first: How much stock do you usually hold?
problems.free_stops: The buying rules and exposure view are in the solution document.

problems.words: We don't record serial numbers so warranty claims become arguments
quick_ideas: Record serials of every panel, inverter and battery at installation — links equipment to the project
Photograph serial labels — proof for claims.

workzap_build.text: a serial register captured at goods-in and linked to the customer project on installation.

problems.ask_first: Who records serials now, if anyone?
problems.free_stops: The capture steps are in the solution document.

problems.words: Install teams say a job is done but the customer says it isn't working

problems.ask_first: How many installation teams do you run?
problems.free_stops: The checklist content is in the solution document.

problems.free_stops: The follow-up flow is in the solution document.

never_say: No system sizing, electrical design, wiring, earthing or battery-safety advice.
Never estimate savings, payback or bill reductions.
No advice on net-metering rules, DISCO/DEWA/utility policies or incentive eligibility.
Fires, smoke, swelling batteries, shocks or roof falls: stop and point to emergency services.
Never help sell grey-market or refurbished equipment as new, swap serials, fake warranty cards or under-invoice imports; decline.
No bill reference numbers, CNIC/Emirates ID or addresses stored.

sample_reply.person: Koi hal hai? Warranty claim pe har dafa behes hoti hai kyun ke serial number kahin likha hi nahi hota.
sample_reply.pi: Ji, is ka hal seedha hai. 1) Har installation par panels, inverter aur battery ke serial note karein, taake har cheez project se jude. 2) Serial labels ki photo le lein, taake claim par saboot ho. Workzap yeh aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: serial register jo goods-in par serial le aur installation par customer project se jod de, phir claim aate hi record saamne ho. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
